# Test fixtures

`prompts.jsonl` and `answers.jsonl` are 6 rows each copied verbatim from
`benchmark_data/` of https://github.com/Khadaz/ChemReason-Bench at commit
`c0b9ac2933708fcca47b1795492952cbf280e194`. `golden_prompts.json` holds the prompts
upstream's own builders render from those rows, used to pin byte-exactness.
